mode: image2image (vanilla CSFF card art as style reference)
prompt:
Reference image 1 and reference image 2 are style references only: match their flat posterized colour fills, thin dark ink outlines, small ink tick marks and muted palette; do not copy their subjects. Reference image 3 is the composition reference: keep its subject and layout exactly, and redraw it in reference 1's style, without its cream paper border.

Subject: an ancient burial cairn under oaks. A long low mound of rounded grey stones heaped high in the centre foreground, grown over with grass and bramble on top, a few loose stones at its foot. Gnarled old oak trunks frame it on the left and right, their branches arching over the top of the picture, more oak trunks receding into a dim green wood behind. Ferns and dry grass in the foreground. No people, no bones, no glowing light.

Style: Card Survival Fantasy Forest game card art. Flat posterized colour fills in a few hard-edged tonal steps, cel-like, no soft gradients, no watercolour bleed, no paper texture, no border or frame. Thin dark ink outlines and small ink hatch and tick marks for texture. Muted naturalistic palette of moss greens, earth browns and grey stone. Realistic proportions, nothing glossy, no fantasy glow, no light rays, no text. Full-bleed painted scene filling the whole 2:3 portrait card edge to edge.
